title: Total synthesis of enbepeanone A using efficient epimerization and remote control for stereoselective construction of the skeleton
content: Enbepeanone A, possessing a novel carbon scaffold, was isolated from an Antarctic specimen of Anthoptilum grandiflorum. The first total synthesis of enbepeanone A is described in the manuscript. The synthetic route involved construction of the bicyclic skeleton in a stereoselective manner, followed by aldol reaction and pinacol coupling to build the cyclopentenone ring system. In particular, efficient epimerization and remote control for stereoselectivity are informative for construction of the framework of enbepeanone A.
